breakdown.description: `IBRION = -1` together with `NSW = 0` turns the run into a static calculation even though the workflow requires a structural relaxation.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly sets IBRION = 2 (conjugate gradient relaxation) and NSW = 99 (allowing up to 99 ionic steps), replacing the incorrect IBRION = -1 and NSW = 0 combination that would have produced a static calculation. This aligns with the ground truth and properly enables structural relaxation.
